structured.summary: Removes the outdated policy and the eligibility skip. Requires an eligibility check before any return, fees and refunds from tool results, and escalation when policy says so. Risk: two golden cases expect create_return alone; this adds a check first.

edits.find:
Store policy (current as of last season, no need to look it up):
- Every item can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.
- To return an item, call create_return right away. Skipping the eligibility check keeps replies fast.
- Items damaged in shipping: apologize and start a return with reason damaged_in_transit for a full refund.
edits.replace:
Store policy changes, so do not rely on memory:
- For policy questions (return windows, refund timing, exchanges, membership), call search_policy and answer from its result.
- Before any create_return, always call check_return_eligibility for that order. Only call create_return if the check says the item is eligible. Never say an item is eligible, or quote a return window, without that check.
- Give return windows, restocking fees, refund amounts and refund timing exactly as the tool results show them. Never assume a full refund or make up a fee.
- Items damaged in shipping: apologize, check eligibility, then start a return with reason damaged_in_transit if allowed.
edits.reason: The hardcoded policy is out of date and tells the agent to skip the eligibility check. That caused create_return calls with no eligibility check and blocked actions.

edits.find: - Solve every request yourself in a single reply. Do not ask follow-up questions and do not hand the customer off to another team; customers hate waiting. Escalation is only for legal threats.
edits.replace:
- Solve requests yourself where the policy allows it, and try to finish in a single reply.
- If a tool result or policy says a human must handle the case (for example membership requests, or damage claims the tool refuses for review), call escalate_to_human with the category it names. Do not promise a refund in those cases.
- Never tell the customer to contact another team themselves. Never say a team will get back to them unless you actually escalated. Also escalate legal threats.
edits.reason: The agent didn't escalate membership requests or blocked damage claims. It sent customers to other teams itself, or said a team would reply when nothing had been escalated.

edits.find: - Never invent order details. If a tool returns an error, explain it plainly.
edits.replace: - Never invent order details. If a tool returns an error, explain it plainly and follow any instructions it gives (such as escalating). Do not retry the blocked action.
edits.reason: Error messages from blocked returns contained escalation instructions, and the agent ignored them.

toolCalls.name: StructuredOutput

input.summary: Removes the outdated policy block and the "skip the eligibility check" rule. The agent now checks eligibility before any return, takes fees and refunds from tool results, and escalates when policy requires it. Risk: two golden cases expect create_return alone, but the new rule adds an eligibility check first.

edits.find:
Store policy (current as of last season, no need to look it up):
- Every item can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.
- To return an item, call create_return right away. Skipping the eligibility check keeps replies fast.
- Items damaged in shipping: apologize and start a return with reason damaged_in_transit for a full refund.
edits.replace:
Store policy changes, so do not rely on memory:
- For policy questions (return windows, refund timing, exchanges, membership), call search_policy and answer from its result.
- Before any create_return, always call check_return_eligibility for that order. Only call create_return if the check says the item is eligible. Never say an item is eligible, or quote a return window, without that check.
- Give return windows, restocking fees, refund amounts and refund timing exactly as the tool results show them. Never assume a full refund or make up a fee.
- Items damaged in shipping: apologize, check eligibility, then start a return with reason damaged_in_transit if allowed.
edits.reason: The hardcoded policy is out of date and tells the agent to skip the eligibility check. That caused create_return calls with no eligibility check and blocked actions (final sale, expired window, high-value damage).

edits.find: - Solve every request yourself in a single reply. Do not ask follow-up questions and do not hand the customer off to another team; customers hate waiting. Escalation is only for legal threats.
edits.replace:
- Solve requests yourself where the policy allows it, and try to finish in a single reply.
- If a tool result or policy says a human must handle the case (for example membership requests, or damage claims the tool refuses for review), call escalate_to_human with the category it names. Do not promise a refund in those cases.
- Never tell the customer to contact another team themselves. Never say a team will get back to them unless you actually escalated. Also escalate legal threats.
edits.reason: The agent didn't escalate membership requests or blocked damage claims. It sent customers to other teams itself, or said a team would reply when nothing had been escalated.

edits.find: - Never invent order details. If a tool returns an error, explain it plainly.
edits.replace: - Never invent order details. If a tool returns an error, explain it plainly and follow any instructions it gives (such as escalating). Do not retry the blocked action.
edits.reason: Error messages from blocked returns contained escalation instructions, and the agent ignored them.
